SyntheticHanaModel.name: CV_ORDER_SALES
SyntheticHanaModel.description: Original synthetic fixture. Fictional company: Northstar Supply. Not exported from or validated in HANA, Qlik or Spotfire. No company data or real BI dashboard is represented.
SyntheticHanaModel.RelationalDefinition: SELECT o.ORDERID, l.ORDERLINEID, o.ORDERDATE, c.CUSTOMERID, c.CUSTOMERNAME, p.STOCKITEMID, p.STOCKITEMNAME, l.QUANTITY, ROUND(l.QUANTITY * l.UNITPRICE, 2) AS ORDERED_VALUE_EX_TAX FROM ORDERLINES l JOIN ORDERS o ON l.ORDERID = o.ORDERID JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMERID = c.CUSTOMERID JOIN STOCKITEMS p ON l.STOCKITEMID = p.STOCKITEMID
